# Automation commands

The editor and players can be driven by a text script (one command per line) for automated tests and tooling: set `CQ_AUTOMATION=<script>` and start the executable. Results are written to `<script>.result.txt`; every command logs OK or FAIL. See [Testing](../Testing.md) for the workflow. `wait <frames>`, `screenshot <png>` and `quit` are always available; the rest are registered by the editor / runtime.

Descriptions are taken from the comments next to each command in the source (Turkish comments are kept as written).
